frontier.hypothesis: The three SetDrawEnv/SetDrawEnv2 orphan sites (pseudos 128, 137, 140) name three concrete three-insn chains combine collapses at a block head, and at least one of them can be routed through one of func_800480C0's two block heads without adding instructions.
frontier.mechanism: class A fires when combine rewrites or deletes the DEF insn of an intermediate pseudo that is not referenced again before the head of its basic block (combine.c:10757-10762 backward scan terminating on the leading JUMP_INSN/CODE_LABEL, plant at combine.c:10836-10841). SetDrawEnv is the tree's only mult-free multiplicity-3 exhibit, and it is ordinary C on main.
frontier.next_probe: tmp/grind/func_800480C0/s6/dumpall.sh already regenerates display's -da dumps. Locate pseudos 128, 137 and 140 in display.flow and display.combine, and write down per site the exact chain combine collapsed and which jump/label the USE was planted after. Then ask, per site, whether that chain can be spelled onto func_800480C0's fallthrough block after `beqz $s1` or its do-while body at .L80048144 without changing the 74-insn stream. Note the s6 class A / class B split means none of the thirty s2-s5 spellings actually tested this.

frontier.hypothesis: Class A and class B stack, so a body carrying both a folded guard (class B, measured 1 here) and a class-A orphan reaches two phantoms / vars=16 on this function.
frontier.mechanism: The two producers are independent: class B is a compare residue local-alloc cannot seat; class A is an orphan USE with no set at all. func_8003FECC, SpuSetReverbModeParam and _SsSeqPlay already show 1 orphan USE alongside 1 non-USE phantom in the same function, i.e. the classes co-exist in shipped ordinary C.
frontier.next_probe: Install rejected/phantom-guard-vars8-ceiling.c (class B, unalloc=1) as the chassis and add whichever class-A trigger frontier 1 identifies; measure with tmp/grind/func_800480C0/s6/probe.sh and record unalloc, vars and the insn delta. Even a costly two-phantom form is worth banking: it is the first measurement above the ceiling s2-s5 established, and it decides whether 4 is an arithmetic sum of the two classes or needs class A alone at multiplicity 4.

frontier.hypothesis: The target's 32 bytes are one 32-byte AGGREGATE from the original source rather than four phantom residues, shared by all four text1b siblings.
frontier.mechanism: function.c assign_stack_local reserves an aggregate slot at RTL-expand from the source DECL and never reclaims frame_offset; a PsyQ MATRIX is exactly 32 bytes. BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG reports ZERO unallocated pseudos for func_80047EE8/func_80047FBC, so the siblings' identical 32-byte regions are a declaration in the shipped source, not residues. This is carried from s5 and remains unspent - and s6's refutation of the bound of two means it is no longer the forced fallback, just the only hypothesis that explains why all four siblings reserve exactly 32.
frontier.next_probe: Forensics on func_800482C8 and on the callers of the four siblings: look for a 32-byte record (MATRIX / 8-word buffer) the original built on the stack and passed by address, whose address-taking this decompilation folded into pointer arithmetic. A LIVE such local is ordinary C and needs no allowlist row.
